Step 3 (Clinical Translation): Median PFS of 5.1 months with no comparator arm makes efficacy assessment difficult, but this appears consistent with standard chemotherapy alone. Step 4 (Population Effects): No subgroup analyses reported. Step 5 (Confounders): Major issues include severe toxicity (14/18 patients with grade 3-5 events including hemorrhages), very small sample size (n=18), and single-arm design preventing proper efficacy assessment. The combination appears to add significant toxicity without clear benefit.
